nom: La Roche-Posay Toleriane Dermallergo Face Moisturizer, 1.35oz

avis.texte: Tiny but mighty! I was a little disappointed about the size and price point. 29.99 for a 1.35 FL. OZ is a little steep for my pocket but a little goes a long way. Its silky and smooth going on, my skin looks dewy. There is a bit of tackiness left behind but it fades after a minute or two. I think it depends on your skin type, mines dryer than a desert and so fsr it hasn't make me break out. I plan to update this after 30 days of use but first impressions are great! My packaging did not come damage, which I was worried about after seeing other reviews. I'm back 30 days later and my skin has never been smoother. There is a definite difference in my pores and skin texture. I've always had fairly decent skin but dealt with dry patches, flaky skin, and black heads on my chin/nose area. Combined with the face wash and care I think this lotion has done very well. It's gentle enough for my skin, no more drying or flaking skin and I get compliments all the time on my skin at work! I usually have trouble with sensitivity as well and this has not caused me any rashes, or itchiness which is a rare thing for me with skin care! Changed my rating from 4 stars to 5, because the tiny and mighty is worth the price for me.

avis.titre: Finally Found a Moisturizer That Doesn’t Irritate My SkinFinally Found a Moisturizer That Doesn’t Irritate My Skin
avis.texte: I’ve been using this moisturizer for a while now, and it’s one of the few products that keeps my skin hydrated without causing irritation. My skin can get very sensitive and reactive, but this cream feels lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves my face soft and comfortable all day. It’s especially helpful whenever my skin barrier feels damaged or irritated because it calms the redness and dryness without feeling greasy. A little goes a long way, and it’s become a staple in my skincare routine. I would definitely recommend it to anyone with sensitive skin looking for a gentle, effective moisturizer.

i really like it! its not greasy and my face still feels moisturized. it doesn’t make my acne more irritated which many moisturizers tend to do. the price is the only flaw for the amount you get but i would buy again!

avis.titre: My asolute favorite moisturized (sensitive skin) and great size for travel !
avis.texte: I absolutely love this moisturizer. I have had normal skill my entire life, until the last two years. 2 years ago, I had a case of dermatitis in the winter (cause for flare up remains a mystery) that resulted in extremely sensitive skin, mostly in winter months, and me needing to protect my skin barrier. As a result, I tried SO MANY moisturizers. This has been my go-to, winter (plus year round when my skin is mostly fine and less sensitive). While a bit expensive for a basic moisturizer that doesn't have any anti-aging characteristics, it is an excellent product. I have tried several others from LaRoche Posay but this is the best for me. I really appreciate the texture (goes on smooth, doesn't feel sticky and has no odor) - but also appreciate the packaging and slim bottle. I travel a ton, and this size is perfect. I would recommend for that alone. Thank you to Amazon for carrying this, i typically do not see this at retail where other LRP products are sold.

I am 65 and after rocesa, ruddy skin texture from early years of acne. My skin is very very sensitive, and will have red hives after reacting to skin products. I tolerate this lotion very well. There is absolutely no scent. My skin feels soft and not sticky after applying. I highly recommend this product, it is expensive but so worth it. I will be a repeat buyer. It is a small bottle, and im thinking it might last a month if I use 3 squints per application. Overall, I love this cream!
Awesome product. I saw results in just a few days. My skin was brighter and looked much healthier.
Second purchase! My second bottle already. Works amazingly well when my skin reacts or flares up—super soothing and gentle!
I love this moisturizer. It's a perfect combination of feeling good on my skin but not greasy. Nice moistu

avis.titre: Great universal face creamGreat universal face cream
avis.texte: Great face cream, I use it also under the eyes. I’ve chosen it because of very good ingredients and perfect packaging (this pump bottle prevent from bacteria and air). It’s very neutral (ingredient-wise) so I use it with hyaluronic serum, vit C serum, peptide serum, niacinamide serum (of course not all together, just one serum and cream on top). The cream fits very well my dry and dehydrated skin. It has no smell (no fragrance and no colorants!). If the producer doesn’t change the ingredients, I’ll buy it again and again. Love it!

Es de las mejores cremas para pieles sensibles. Sus ingredientes son muy buenos, calman muy bien la piel. Ojo, es una crema mas bien nutritiva que hidratante, es mejor usarla después de un serum hidratante. Es mi crema básica favorita para después de un tratamiento con activos (como el ácido, por ejemplo), ya que no tiene ingredientes activos y no tendría conflictos con ningún tratamiento especial. Tengo la piel fina, sensible y mixta, en verano de día es demasiado pesada, pero para el invierno es ideal. No me provoca acné ni puntos negros, combate bien las zonas con sequedad. En definitiva, la seguiré comprando como siempre y la super recomiendo probar.
It makes my face really good, It fits the eyes circle too 💜💜

avis.titre: On my 3rd bottle!  Rosascea / sensitive skin friendly!
avis.texte: *update to my previous 5 star review - decided to knock off a star for the overall packaging. See photo. I’ve repeatedly purchased this product - I believe this is now my 4th new bottle but what’s frustrating is the packaging does not allow you to get all of the product out. I can’t twist off the top and squeeze / scoop out the last of the moisturizer so for the price point - it does waste product which is frustrating. ** I am so so so happy I gave this moisturizer a try during the winter. My skin was dry, flaky, texture-y, bumpy, all things horrible due to my rosacea. I tend to flare in the winter months and look like Rudolph and unfortunately had to switch dermatologists to get the Rx I wanted to help. But this moisturizer provided some relief before I got my Rx (Soolantra) and I used this with my Rx and without. Once my rosacea calmed down - I was able to repair my skin barrier with this lotion during the day, and I did cicablast at night. Love the pump and love how it just glides across my face.
This is my go to moisturizer. I have problems skin on my face, and it keeps the flakiness down. I pair this with the thermal springwater

FREAKING AMAZING!!! I have rosacia and my skin was dry and red and gross and with advise from my daughter I bought this and oh my gosh I love it!!! My skin is so soft-and not dry—my daughter said that my skin is shining. This stuff does NOT make my face burn or sting!!!!

I had bad acne, and after using their acne product was left with dry skin (to be expected!). I wanted something that would last longer and keep my skin moisturized. This has been awesome. It has no scent, and is not oily. It lasts a long time and you don't need a lot to keep it on. I love the locking mechanism of the product, it is nice for traveling. I will say, if you aren't struggling with dry skin and have a moisturizer you love already, it might not be worth it for the amount given. But if you want maybe an upgrade from the moisturizer you have currently, where maybe you have flaky skin even after moisturizing (like me) this is so healing and nice for sensitive skin. highly recommended.

Update: Shame on me, I wrote my last review too quickly. After trying many facial moisturizers, this one has been by far the best and I have ordered it again. As compared to others, it doesn't take that much and it feels like silk on the face. I found the $$ - ha-ha! I like everything about it but the tiny size with a big price tag. Pic of ballpoint pen to show size.

This is my 5th bottles. I travel extensively and this is perfect. Light weight, can see how much left in the bottle. Air tight packaging so its stays fresh. I have dry skin and its nicely smooth on my skin. I recommend it very much !

The pump just stopped. Plenty of product in bottle. Past return period so I had to pry off lid. Recommended by my Dermatologist told to use sparingly and I love results but there is 3/4 of moisturizer left in bottle and am going to have to use a knitting needle or long nail to get product out of bottle. Very disappointing.

Item was not sealed and missing top. Makes me question whether it was used. Tried to request an exchange or return and thats apparently not an option. In that case items should be delivered in a complete package specifically for beauty products.

avis.titre: Defective pumps don’t waste your money
avis.texte: Finally arrived and the airless pump doesn’t work. Amazon will not replace and refers you to La Roche Posay. For $25 I expect it to work or receive a replacement. Now I have to wait for an email from manufacturer, send photos and see what they will do as well as go out and buy something else! Ridiculous! Many reviews online with the same problem and if the pump works you can’t get alot of the product out as the liquid is depleted. Total waste of money.

avis.titre: Damaged box, better not to buy from Amazon
avis.texte: Great product but poor handling. The box was all torn up, good thing no damage was done to the bottle itself.

This moisturizer it makes your face feel extremely soft I like it a lot but the price is ridiculous for 1.35 FL OZ I’m definitely going to use this in very small amounts because I’m balling on a budget❣️

I really wanted to love this product, but experienced a crazy breakout after using it, and their AP Balm and cleanser. I tried each individually, and have had the same reaction. I don't typically have sensitive skin, but was just looking for non-scented super hydrating moisturizer. Thankfully I was able to get a refund on two of the three products, as they are pretty expensive. Disappointed in the third not being returnable (the cleaner). These came highly recommended by a friend, so sad to have to leave this review.
